data.body: Candidate commit cb575290845440e74c579d1ebfba0a9b945732e9 changes exactly the six declared infra/compose files with 213 inserted and 770 deleted lines, all standalone comments or adjacent blanks. A stronger line-by-line comparison confirms every non-comment configuration or executable line and each Docker syntax directive are byte-exact. Green evidence at this SHA includes config-check, 299 focused tests with 23 expected skips, repository lint, repository typecheck, diff --check, comment-policy punctuation scan, and commit-ticket verification. The initial focused run had one failure because test_reviewbot_entrypoint.py consumes the literal '# Data-capture entrypoint' anchor; the anchor was restored in the condensed block and the full focused rerun passed. Append-only verification correction: the persisted preserve-executable-lines command uses escaped basic-regex grouping, but git diff --ignore-matching-lines parses an extended regular expression. The persisted spelling exits 1 on comment-only diffs; the syntax-correct equivalent with unescaped grouping and alternation exits 0, and the stronger independent line comparison also passes. Per operator direction, no full local test suite was run. Awaiting non-author exact-candidate semantic and bloat-removal review before any Gerrit push.
